name: The Church of Avacyn
description: The human church named for its leader, the archangel Avacyn, which humans brandish against the horrors.

timeline.summary: Humans fight back with torch-wielding mobs, trained cathars, and the power of the Church of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: They train specialized holy warriors called cathars to strike back against the supernatural horrors.

relations.note: The Church is named for its leader.
relations.quote: The Church is named for its leader, the powerful archangel Avacyn
